body: Oh, and _templatePushedOrHeadPopped_ needs to be writable from the tree builder push/pop operations.
This makes the spec basically allow WebKit and Chromium's approach as conforming, for `meta` detection.
This allows Gecko's deterministic behavior and Chromium's non-deterministic behavior, and WebKit's lack of autodetection.
Only Gecko renavigates currently. I think it would be nice if we could get rid of it, but this can be follow-up investigation.
